3755-4770-6090-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

971-4687-5268.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4687-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

710-1052-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3585-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4247-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

3967-4640-7082--201.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

225-1308-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5404-7504.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
5404-7504.description:
Declare Raphael as an attacker. Shaun triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Raphael that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the Raphael token. It triggers, untapping all attacking creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-2946-4556-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2921-2946-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1355-1879.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-1879.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-3112-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

907-1558-3875-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-3875-4231-6441.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-2769-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-2769-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

698-4200-6867.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-4200-6867.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 3.

1734-2292-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-2292-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

4365-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4365-5526-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

2366-4885-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4885-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3661-4763-5231--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {R}.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2438-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

225-539-872-3478.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaled Herbalist as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

575-5624-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1974-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan
1974-3362.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Quicksilver Gargantuan's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-3240-6462-6560.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3394-5231-6249--5.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3394-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {R}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

224-1525-2248-3848.notablePrerequisites:
Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least seven lands.
224-1525-2248-3848.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Omnath's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control, and then causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Repeat.

304-1978-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Tough Cookie.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

1965-3184.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Yomiji triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

184-2557-3883.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-2557-3883.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1348-4657-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
Market Festival attached to any mana-producing land you control.
1348-4657-4878.description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate the land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and the land with Market Festival attached.
Repeat from step 2.

738-1646-2364-4659-5111.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to one.
738-1646-2364-4659-5111.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to one.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Mana Vault and Acorn Catapult, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Acorn Catapult ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, causing it to die due to having zero toughness, and causing its controller to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the opponent's creature dies, Glissa triggers twice, returning Acorn Catapult and Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Acorn Catapult and Mana Vault by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2948-3146-4279-4929.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2948-3146-4279-4929.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding Voidwing Hybrid, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Voidwing Hybrid triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand twice by paying {2}, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

430-1061-3145.notablePrerequisites:
Commander's Authority attached to a creature other than Timestream Navigator.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-3145.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, the creature Commander's Authority is attached to triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

337-776-1329-5281.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-5281.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Herbal Poultice to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Herbal Poultice.
Cast Herbal Poultice.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

641-2018-4053.description:
Cast Kroxa by paying {B}{R}.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and then lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Kroxa dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

799-1750-4903-5261.notablePrerequisites: Any legendary creature or planeswalker under your control.
799-1750-4903-5261.description:
Cast the extra turn spell and move to your extra turn.
Activate Isochron Sceptre to cast Pull from Eternity, putting the extra turn spell from exile to your graveyard.
Attack with Backdraft Hellkite to give your extra turn flashback, then cast it.
Repeat for infinite turns.
